description: Routing golden set (Phase 9). route/domains: what the CODE router must decide (sensitive -> human review). required: specialists that must research the question; forbidden: specialists a well-scoped plan should not use. Specialists are judged on the Planner types after the Orchestrator's assignment was validated in code (what actually runs). Traps are standard questions that contain a word a naive keyword router would flag.
